* Learn to give agents clear instructions and enough context, using our in-house AI skills and workflows.

Start Your Nursing Career with Broad Experience
  
  
If you're a new graduate nurse looking for an opportunity to build a strong clinical foundation, develop confidence, and gain experience caring for a variety of patients, the Float Pool at Lutheran Hospital is a great place to begin your nursing career.
  
  
As a Float Pool RN, you'll have the opportunity to work across different departments based on patient care and staffing needs. This exposure allows you to strengthen your assessment, prioritization, communication, and clinical skills while learning from experienced nurses and interdisciplinary teams throughout the hospital.
  
  
New graduate nurses hired into this position will also be automatically enrolled in our year-long Nurse Residency Program, providing additional education, professional development, mentorship, and support as you transition from nursing school into professional practice.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Respond to patient care needs by answering call lights, assisting with hygiene and nourishment, obtaining vital signs, and communicating effectively and promptly with members of the care team.
* Perform clinical skills and tasks within defined competencies, including insertion, maintenance, and removal of peripheral IVs, Foley catheters, and nasogastric tubes.
* Perform venipuncture.
* Provide safe wound care.
* Check and document patient vital signs, blood glucose, intake, and output.
* Perform secondary assessments in addition to the primary assessment performed by a Registered Nurse, as appropriate.
* Provide patient and family education related to disease processes, medications, and interventions included in the plan of care.
* Administer medications, when applicable, with direct Registered Nurse supervision and required dual sign-off.
* Document patient care with the additional signature of a Registered Nurse when required.
* Assist nurses and physicians within established scope and competency.
* Actively contribute to patient experience goals.
* Assist with patient transfers, admissions, and discharges while following safe patient-handling practices.
* Support organizational mission, vision, values, and service behavior standards.
* Follow established infection prevention standards.
* Float to other departments based on individual competency, qualifications, and business needs.
* Participate in on-call coverage during a regularly scheduled shift when required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Graduate of an accredited BSN or ADN nursing program with all required clinical coursework completed.
* RN License in state of Colorado or if holding a compact license from another state, must be transferred to Colorado within 60 days of starting.
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Current American Heart Association Basic Life Support for Healthcare Providers (BLS-HCP) certification upon hire, or obtained within 60 days of hire with prior approval.

Why Start in the Float Pool?
  
  
The Float Pool is an excellent starting point for a new graduate nurse who wants to develop a well-rounded nursing foundation. You'll gain exposure to different patient populations, diagnoses, workflows, and care teams, helping you strengthen your clinical judgment, adaptability, time management, and confidence.
  
  
Instead of beginning your career with experience in just one specialty, the Float Pool gives you the opportunity to broaden your nursing skills while discovering the patient populations and areas of care you're most passionate about.
  
  
With the support of experienced nurses, leaders, and the year-long Nurse Residency Program, you'll have resources designed to help you successfully transition from nursing student to professional RN.
  
  
If you're flexible, eager to learn, and excited to build a broad foundation for your nursing career, we encourage you to apply to the Lutheran Hospital Float Pool.
  
  
**Apply today and start building a nursing career with possibilities in every direction.**
